inputs.original_text: Earlier this month, an Indiana judge blocked a prolife law, arguing that limiting abortion violates freedom of religion. The claim, brought by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, argued that an Indiana law “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” Judge Christina R. [...] The post This Judge Thinks Killing Babies in Abortions is a Religious Right appeared first on LifeNews.com .
inputs.modified_text:
Look at what is happening to our country. Earlier this month, an Indiana judge—specifically Judge Christina R.—blocked a vital prolife law under the pretext that limiting abortion supposedly violates freedom of religion. 

This disgraceful move to subvert the rule of law and our enduring moral heritage was brought forward by the American Civil Liberties Union and Hoosier Jews for Choice, who had the audacity to claim that protecting unborn children “violates religious freedoms by burdening the ability to obtain an abortion in accordance with their sincerely held beliefs.” 

When secular progressive organizations and fringe groups weaponize the courts to enshrine abortion as a sacred rite, they are spitting in the face of family values and the millions of Americans who believe in basic human decency and the right to life. This is the bitter fruit of activist judges advancing a radical culture of death and prioritizing judicial activism over innocent life. We must stand up for tradition, authority, and the sanctity of life before our moral foundation is completely eroded.
